$meta.source: Reconciled from v1.0 (marketing palette) + v2.0 (app design-system). Canonical block is WEBSITE_BUILD_SPEC.md §2; where this file and the spec disagree, the spec wins.
notes: One accent colour only: Electric Blue (#2563EB). The hero gradient is sanctioned on the home hero ONLY; everywhere else uses flat fills.
No emoji. Icons: Lucide-style ~2px stroke, used sparingly.
Australian English, day-first dates, tabular numerals for figures.
Wordmark: DEFEX with X in Electric Blue; ENGINEERING justified edge-to-edge beneath.
Mark: Option A 'Engineered' — X in rounded frame, blue diamond centre, uniform arms.
Inter is self-hosted (latin subset, weights 300–700). No runtime external font request.

blue.usage: Actions, links, active nav, focus ring, the X-mark diamond. The only accent.

navy.usage: Headings, wordmark, dark surfaces (footer, CTA band, hero overlay base)

steel.usage: Secondary text, captions, eyebrows on light

concrete.usage: Hairlines on dark surfaces, muted fills

gradients.usage: Home hero only, over hero-architecture.jpg. Nowhere else.

rules.displayHero: weight 300, generous size (tagline H1 is weight 600 for authority)
rules.eyebrow: 13px, ALL CAPS, tracking 0.1em, weight 600, Steel (Concrete on dark)

effects.shadowBrand: soft blue lift on interactive-card hover
effects.motion: 200ms ease global; entrances cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) 300ms, translate-y 12px + fade, staggered ≤3; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion; duration window 150–300ms

voice.style: Plain, competent, Australian. Direct, specific, never salesy. No exclamation marks. No emoji. No banned superlatives (leading, best, trusted, premier).
voice.casing: Marketing eyebrows ALL-CAPS wide-tracked; body Sentence case
